title: 2004 AMC 12B Problem 16
statement: A function \(f\) is defined by \(f(z) = i\overline{z},\) where \(i = \sqrt{-1}\) and \(\overline{z}\) is the complex conjugate of \(z.\) How many values of \(z\) satisfy both \(|z| = 5\) and \(f(z) = z?\)

solutions.text:
Writing \(z = x + iy,\) we get \(f(z) = i(x - iy) = y + ix.\) Setting \(f(z) = z\) gives \(y = x,\) which is a line through the origin. The condition \(|z| = 5\) is a circle, and a line through the center meets the circle in \(2\) points.

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: \(f(z) = z\) forces \(y = x,\) a line; intersect it with the circle \(|z| = 5\)
